name: loom
description: Reads across connected Gmail threads to assemble background, then writes a draft response for you to review. Sending, archiving, deleting and trashing are all off the table, and it also carries webhook-hosting skills for anyone wanting to wire it into something else.

official.title: loom by Lauren
official.description: Gathers context across related Gmail threads and drafts a reply. Never sends, deletes, archives, or trashes mail. Includes skills to host a webhook...
